basis_note: S&P 500 dated membership windows (sp1500_pit_membership, src=sp500); a member counts only on sessions inside its own window; sector labels are as of now, not era-correct
no_outcomes: series only: no outcome relation, no regime assignment, no trading call of any kind, on any period
scope: series only: group and universe numbers; no member ticker, row or price; no regime assignment of any kind; archive aggregates and counts only

start.note: first dated membership start; averages and 252-session windows read the member's own earlier archive closes, which may predate its entry

index.rebalance_rule: engine.baskets._ew_level: each session the index return is the plain mean of the daily total returns of the members priced that session (daily rebalance to equal weight), chained from 1.0 on the group's first valid session
index.floor_gap: On a session with fewer than 2 priced members the level is missing (reason below_index_member_floor) and that session carries no return; the chain resumes from the last valid level.

high_beta_computed.rule: top fifth of universe members by trailing 252-session beta to SPY daily returns (cov/var on 252 paired daily returns, full window required), ranked at each month's last session, held the next month; ties broken by ticker; equal-weight daily rebalance within the held month, same _ew_level chaining from 1.0
high_beta_computed.selection_set: dated members at the selection session

price_source: Tiingo EOD archive /Volumes/Mastermind/market-data/tiingo (normalized eod-bars, captures 2026-10-11..16) via scripts/build_tiingo_member_closes.py; member-level, off git
price_note: Adjusted closes are the archive's restated values (split and dividend adjustment as of the 2026-10-11..16 capture), not the prices printed at the time. Group-level shares and counts only; no member prices. The Tiingo research reader marks raw views redistribution_admitted=false; member-level history stays off git.
missing: 453 dated membership rows have no stored close inside their own membership window and are absent (of these, 144 tickers exist in the store only outside the window, a likely ticker reuse); 484 membership rows carry no sector label and are absent from every sector; labels are as of now, not era-correct. Duplicate-series scan: no two member tickers carry the same price series (identical daily returns or a constant price ratio).
dropped_partial_rows_rule: centred 21-row median of priced names; a row under half is dropped. Looks ahead up to 10 rows to decide which rows are sessions; values themselves use only data on or before their date.
dropped_partial_rows_note: same archive and rule as the house dated sector history; the session list lives in group_breadth_dated_sp500.meta.json
duplicate_series_rule: month-by-month hash of daily returns, then pairwise check: >=60 identical returns and >=95% identical between the first and last identical session. Detection and labelling only; no store repaired. Names withheld under the archive rule.
not_included: curated basket relative indices (ai_software, non_ai_software, IGV, SOXX and SPHB legs) are not included: no dated membership exists for curated baskets. The computed high-beta group IS included; it is derived from the dated universe.
